name: Rebl Group Oyj
summary: Rebl Group Oyj, operating through its subsidiaries, primarily specializes in the printing and design of magazines and newspapers across Finland. The company's activities are organized into three distinct business segments: Printing, Visibility, and Digital. In addition to these core services, Rebl Group also furnishes advertising print products and comprehensive planning and logistics solutions for marketing initiatives. Its digital arm specifically encompasses brand and product information management solutions, alongside services aimed at enhancing digital visibility. Formerly known as PunaMusta Media Oyj, the company adopted its current name, Rebl Group Oyj, in September 2024. This Finnish enterprise was established in Joensuu in 1874.
